description: Use when getting a market by source and market ID. Includes parent event, chart and citation. Read `kind` first. Tombstones give last observations and known results after archive at 10 days past event close. Archives before late November 2026 return 404. Try get_event. Check `quote_tier`. Label non-firm prices by tier.

market_id.description: Market ID native to the source. Composite key with `source`.

source.description: Single venue ID. See get_status for public IDs.

name: get_market
title: Get a market
